learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Committed long side 5 for a right triangle with short sides 3 and 4.
observations.exploration: Moved slider to pairs endpoint, inspected settled layout with empty squares 9 and 16; checked halfway then returned to corners, where one empty tilted square read 25. Slider has three discrete states. Initial endpoint screenshot caught motion; later settled screenshot verified final packing.
observations.reveal: Explained same four triangles and frame leave same empty area, so c times c equals 9 plus 16 equals 25. Generalized to short sides a and b and a squared plus b squared equals c squared.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected at corners, halfway and settled pairs. Congruent triangle colours, square frame and area labels align; motion temporarily overlaps triangles but endpoints form the claimed packing. Reveal readable.
